label: valid
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT 'pilot' source_system,cast(1 AS BIGINT) type_id,id,to_json(array(id)) logical_key_json,'r1' schema_revision,cast(0 AS BIGINT) entity_version,'{"103":"old"}' props_json,'{"future":true}' retained_json,cast(NULL AS BIGINT) root_id,'S' source_feed,'e' source_epoch,cast(0 AS BIGINT) source_position,current_timestamp() published_at,'{"103":"new"}' new_props FROM VALUES (1L),(2L) AS ids(id)),o AS (SELECT source_system,type_id,id,logical_key_json,schema_revision,cast(2 AS BIGINT) entity_version,new_props props_json,retained_json,root_id,source_feed,source_epoch,cast(2 AS BIGINT) source_position,published_at FROM s),j AS (SELECT source_system,'object' entity_kind,type_id,id,cast(103 AS BIGINT) property_id,cast(2 AS BIGINT) entity_version,'update' operation,true old_present,'"old"' old_json,true new_present,'"new"' new_json,'r1' schema_revision,'S' source_feed,'e' source_epoch,cast(2 AS BIGINT) source_position,id event_ordinal,'synthetic-batch:2' source_time_text FROM s) SELECT count(*)<>2 OR count_if(o.source_system IS DISTINCT FROM s.source_system OR o.type_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.type_id OR o.id IS DISTINCT FROM s.id OR o.logical_key_json IS DISTINCT FROM s.logical_key_json OR o.schema_revision IS DISTINCT FROM s.schema_revision OR o.retained_json IS DISTINCT FROM s.retained_json OR o.root_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.root_id OR o.source_feed IS DISTINCT FROM s.source_feed OR o.source_epoch IS DISTINCT FROM s.source_epoch OR o.props_json IS DISTINCT FROM s.new_props OR o.entity_version IS DISTINCT FROM 2 OR o.source_position IS DISTINCT FROM 2 OR o.published_at IS NULL OR j.id IS NULL OR j.property_id IS DISTINCT FROM 103 OR j.entity_version IS DISTINCT FROM 2 OR j.operation IS DISTINCT FROM 'update' OR j.old_present IS DISTINCT FROM true OR j.new_present IS DISTINCT FROM true OR j.schema_revision IS DISTINCT FROM 'r1' OR j.event_ordinal IS DISTINCT FROM s.id OR j.source_time_text IS DISTINCT FROM 'synthetic-batch:2' OR from_json(concat('[',j.old_json,']'),'ARRAY<STRING>')[0] IS DISTINCT FROM get_json_object(s.props_json,'$.103') OR from_json(concat('[',j.new_json,']'),'ARRAY<STRING>')[0] IS DISTINCT FROM get_json_object(s.new_props,'$.103'))<>0 invalid FROM s LEFT JOIN o ON s.source_system=o.source_system AND s.type_id=o.type_id AND s.id=o.id LEFT JOIN j ON j.source_system=s.source_system AND j.entity_kind='object' AND j.type_id=s.type_id AND j.id=s.id AND j.source_feed='S' AND j.source_epoch='e' AND j.source_position=2
